Summary: When Kira's resistance cell learns that the Dominion will soon be bringing down the Federation's minefield, they plot to hinder the enemy's progress. But matters are complicated when the Female Changeling arrives on Terok Nor and pays Odo a visit. Meanwhile, Captain Sisko is relieved of command of the Defiant while Jadzia commands it on a mission.

Name: "Favor the Bold"
Summary: Tired of being on the losing end of the war, Captain Sisko convinces Starfleet Command to launch a fleet of starships to retake Deep Space 9. Meanwhile, time may be running out for Rom.

Name: "Sacrifice of Angels"
Summary: A large fleet of Federation ships head towards Deep Space 9 to stop the Dominion destroying the Wormhole minefield. A Dominion fleet meets them in battle. Can the Defiant make it in time?

Name: "You Are Cordially Invited"
Summary: When Worf and Jadzia decide to bring forward their wedding, the matriarch of the House of Martok challenges Worf and Dax's marriage.

Name: "Resurrection"
Summary: An alternate version of Vedek Bareil arrives from the mirror universe seeking refuge.

Name: "Statistical Probabilities"
Summary: Bashir helps a group of eccentric fellow genetically engineered Humans try to make a useful contribution to the Federation; the Dominion offers to sign a truce with the Federation.

Name: "The Magnificent Ferengi"
Summary: When Quark's mother Ishka is captured by the Dominion, Quark, Rom, and Nog lead a team of Ferengi into a meeting on Empok Nor with Keevan as their payment.

Name: "Waltz"
Summary: Following the destruction of the starship Honshu, Sisko is severely injured and trapped alone on a deserted planet with Dukat, who becomes increasingly unstable.

Name: "Who Mourns for Morn?"
Summary: Morn dies, leaving his entire estate to Quark, but some of Morn's old acquaintances want a piece of the action.

Name: "Far Beyond the Stars"
Writer(s): Marc Scott Zicree, Ira Steven Behr, Hans Beimler
Summary: Experiencing a vision from the Prophets, Sisko sees himself as Benny Russell, a science-fiction writer in the 1950s, who struggles with civil rights and inequality when he writes the story of Captain Benjamin Sisko, a black commander of a futuristic space station.

Name: "One Little Ship"
Summary: O'Brien, Dax, Bashir, and their runabout are reduced in size while investigating an anomaly. Meanwhile, the Jem'Hadar attack and commandeer the Defiant, leaving the runabout crew with no choice but to take their miniature ship inside the Defiant and help Sisko and the others recapture the vessel.

Name: "Honor Among Thieves"
Summary: O'Brien, working undercover for Starfleet Intelligence, infiltrates the Orion Syndicate, the Alpha Quadrant's main organized crime ring, and befriends the man he will have to betray.

Name: "Change of Heart"
Summary: On a mission to recover a Federation informant on the Dominion world of Soukara, Dax is injured and Worf must choose between completing the mission or saving his wife. Meanwhile, O'Brien enlists Bashir's help to defeat Quark in a game of tongo.

Name: "Wrongs Darker Than Death or Night"
Summary: Kira uses the Orb of Time to travel into the past after Dukat claims that her mother was once his lover during the Occupation.

Name: "Inquisition"
Summary: An officer from the Starfleet Department of Internal Affairs arrives on the station and accuses Dr. Bashir of being a Dominion spy.

Name: "In the Pale Moonlight"
Summary: With mounting losses in the Federation-Dominion war, and the specter of defeat, Captain Sisko enlists Garak's help to "persuade" the Romulans to join the Federation/Klingon alliance to win the war. However, Sisko soon learns that to save the Federation he may have to betray the values it stands for.

Name: "His Way"
Summary: Odo consults a holographic lounge singer about his relationship with Kira.

Name: "The Reckoning"
Writer(s): Harry M. Werksman, Gabrielle Stanton, David Weddle, Bradley Thompson
Summary: The discovery of a thirty-thousand-year-old Bajoran tablet buried under the holy city of B'hala announces the Reckoning, the time when the future of Bajor will be decided.

Name: "Valiant"
Summary: Fleeing a Jem'Hadar attack aboard a runabout, Jake and Nog are rescued by a Defiant-class ship crewed by over-eager Red Squad cadets who are biting off more than they can chew.

Name: "Profit and Lace"
Summary: Grand Nagus Zek is deposed after he begins to promote female rights; Quark changes his sex temporarily to prevent Brunt from becoming the new Grand Nagus.

Name: "Time's Orphan"
Writer(s): Allan Kroeker, David Weddle, Bradley Thompson
Summary: An accident on the planet Golana sends Molly O'Brien through a time portal three hundred years into the past into an uninhabited world. Beamed back too late, Molly returns to the present eighteen years old with no immediate recollection of her life or her family.

Name: "The Sound of Her Voice"
Summary: The Defiant receives a distress call from a Starfleet captain stranded on an inhospitable planet.

Name: "Tears of the Prophets"
Summary: Sisko leads an invasion of Cardassian territory, ignoring a warning from the Prophets, with fatal consequences for a member of the DS9 crew.

Name: "Image in the Sand"
Summary: Sisko tries to regain contact with the Prophets.

Name: "Shadows and Symbols"
Summary: Sisko searches for the mysterious Orb of the Emissary. Worf, Martok, Bashir, O'Brien, and Quark attack a Dominion shipyard in orbit around Monac IV. Kira confronts the Romulans over their arming of their hospital base. Deep Space 9 also receives a new resident who has a very familiar name.

Name: "Afterimage"
Summary: Ezri Dax has trouble adjusting with the rest of the crew; Garak inexplicably collapses.

Name: "Take Me Out to the Holosuite"
Summary: When Captain Solok of the Federation starship T'Kumbra challenges former classmate Sisko and his crew to a game of baseball, Sisko refuses to lose to the arrogant Vulcan and begins to take the game too seriously.

Name: "Chrysalis"
Summary: Jack, Lauren, Patrick, and Sarina, the genetically-engineered Humans, return to the station, asking Bashir to help rouse Sarina from her cataleptic state.

Name: "Treachery, Faith and the Great River"
Writer(s): Philip Kim, David Weddle, Bradley Thompson
Summary: Odo is contacted by Weyoun, who reveals that he wants to defect to the Federation. Meanwhile, O'Brien and Nog sail down the Great Material Continuum.

Name: "Once More Unto the Breach"
Summary: With the Dominion War raging, the old Klingon warrior Kor feels left out of the action, and looks for some way to get his share of the honor of battle. However, his efforts to play a part are stymied by Martok, who holds a grudge against Kor.

Name: "The Siege of AR-558"
Summary: During a supply run to AR-558, Sisko finds the defending Starfleet unit with over two thirds of the troops dead and the remaining soldiers' morale extremely low. When the Defiant comes under attack, Sisko, Bashir, Dax, Nog, and Quark choose to remain on the planet, which is about to come under attack by a much larger contingent of Jem'Hadar soldiers.

Name: "Covenant"
Summary: Kira is abducted by a cult that worships the Pah-wraiths and is led by their "Master" – Dukat.

Name: "It's Only a Paper Moon"
Writer(s): David Alan Mack, John J. Ordover, Ronald D. Moore
Summary: In the aftermath of an injury that left him disabled on AR-558, Nog returns to Deep Space 9, but finds he cannot go on living his uncertain life and seeks shelter within the fictional world of Vic Fontaine and Las Vegas, 1962.

Name: "Prodigal Daughter"
Summary: Ezri returns to her home to ask her family's help in finding O'Brien, who disappeared while searching for the widow of a dead friend.

Name: "The Emperor's New Cloak"
Summary: When Grand Nagus Zek is kidnapped by the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance while on a business trip into the "mirror universe", Quark and Rom follow him there.

Name: "Field of Fire"
Summary: After several crew members are murdered, Ezri summons the memories and personality of Joran Dax to help her find the murderer.

Name: "Chimera"
Summary: Odo meets another of the hundred Changelings who were sent out to explore the galaxy.

Name: "Badda-Bing, Badda-Bang"
Summary: When holographic mobsters take over Vic Fontaine's lounge, Bashir, O'Brien, and Vic's other friends plot to run Vic's rival out of business and restore the program to normal.

Name: "Inter Arma Enim Silent Leges"
Summary: Attending a conference on Romulus, Dr. Bashir becomes embroiled in an elaborate scheme devised by Section 31 as a way to ensure the Romulans remain on the side of the Federation in the Dominion War.

Name: "Penumbra"
Summary: Sisko plans to marry Kasidy Yates; Worf is missing after a battle with the Dominion.

Name: "'Til Death Do Us Part"
Summary: Sisko agonizes over his vision from the Prophets, telling him not to marry Kasidy; Kai Winn receives a vision foretelling a "guide" who will help her restore Bajor; Ezri and Worf are interrogated by the Breen.

Name: "Strange Bedfellows"
Summary: The Dominion and the Breen negotiate an alliance; Ezri and Worf are sentenced to death.

Name: "The Changing Face of Evil"
Summary: The Breen ally with the Dominion and attack Earth, the Federation Alliance loses its foothold in Cardassian space, Legate Damar organizes a rebellion, and Kai Winn begins to read forbidden texts about the Pah-wraiths.

Name: "When It Rains..."
Summary: Sisko and Kira aid Damar's rebellion against the Dominion; Bashir discovers that Odo is infected with the disease that is threatening the Founders.

Name: "Tacking Into the Wind"
Summary: Gowron begins reckless attacks against the Dominion; Kira and the Cardassians plot to steal a Breen weapon.

Name: "Extreme Measures"
Summary: Bashir and O'Brien lure a Section 31 agent to the station in a desperate search for the cure to the disease that is killing Odo.

Name: "The Dogs of War"
Writer(s): Peter Allan Fields, René Echevarria, Ronald D. Moore
Summary: Kira, Damar, and Garak are ambushed on Cardassia; Quark receives a message from Grand Nagus Zek appointing him the next leader of the Ferengi Alliance.

Name: "What You Leave Behind"
Summary: In this last adventure, the Federation Alliance prepares a final invasion of Cardassia. Meanwhile on Bajor, Kai Winn releases the Pah-wraiths from the Fire Caves which threatens the safety of not only Bajor, but the entire Alpha Quadrant.

Name: "Caretaker"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Michael Piller and Jeri Taylor
Summary: The newly commissioned starship Voyager and a Maquis raider are flung into the far reaches of the remote Delta Quadrant by a powerful entity known as the Caretaker.

Name: "Parallax"
Summary: Investigating an apparent distress call, Voyager becomes trapped inside the event horizon of a quantum singularity.

Name: "Time and Again"
Summary: While investigating a massive explosion that destroyed all life on a planet, Janeway and Paris are swept back a day in time, where they must prevent the explosion.

Name: "Phage"
Writer(s): Timothy DeHaas, Skye Dent, Brannon Braga
Summary: Neelix's lungs are removed by a race that suffers from a deadly phage that is slowly destroying their population prompting them to harvest replacement organs and tissues from other species.

Name: "The Cloud"
Writer(s): Brannon Braga, Tom Szollosi, Michael Piller
Summary: With energy reserves nearly depleted, Voyager investigates possible resources inside a nebula, which is not what it seems.

Name: "Eye of the Needle"
Writer(s): Hilary J. Bader, Bill Dial, Jeri Taylor
Summary: Voyager makes contact with a Romulan ship through a wormhole that leads back to the Alpha Quadrant.

Name: "Ex Post Facto"
Summary: Tom Paris is convicted of murder. He denies having committed the crime, even though the images extracted from the victim's own memory seem to prove his guilt.

Name: "Emanations"
Summary: Investigating mineral deposits on an asteroid, Harry Kim is trapped on an alien planet.

Name: "Prime Factors"
Writer(s): David R. George III, Eric A. Stillwell, Michael Perricone, Greg Elliot
Summary: The crew of Voyager discovers a planet that has the technology to send them more than halfway along their journey home. However, the planet's inhabitants are more than reluctant to share this technology with Voyager's crew, as doing so would violate one of the society's own prime directives.

Name: "State of Flux"
Summary: An unknown Voyager crew member secretly sends information to the Kazon.

Name: "Heroes and Demons"
Summary: When several crew members disappear inside Harry Kim's "Beowulf" holodeck program, the holographic Doctor is the only one who can rescue them.

Name: "Cathexis"
Summary: Voyager attempts to investigate an unknown energy force that has rendered Chakotay brain-dead, while an unknown entity keeps turning them back.

Name: "Faces"
Summary: The Vidiians capture B'Elanna Torres and split her into two people, one fully Klingon, and one fully Human.

Name: "Jetrel"
Writer(s): James Thomton, Scott Nimerfro, Jack Klein, Karen Klein, Kenneth Biller
Summary: The scientist who developed a weapon that killed three hundred thousand of Neelix's people in a war fifteen years ago boards Voyager, claiming that Neelix is terminally ill.

Name: "Learning Curve"
Summary: Tuvok conducts a training session for Maquis personnel. Meanwhile, Voyager's bio-neural gel packs are mysteriously failing.

Name: "The 37's"
Summary: While investigating the origins of a 1936 Ford truck floating in space, Voyager discovers a 434-year-old Earth mystery on a distant planet.

Name: "Initiations"
Summary: Chakotay becomes caught up in a young Kazon's rite of passage.

Name: "Projections"
Summary: The Doctor is informed that he is actually Lewis Zimmerman, the creator of the EMH, he is trapped on a holographic Voyager on Jupiter Station, and his whole Voyager experience was on a holodeck.

Name: "Elogium"
Writer(s): Jimmy Diggs, Steve J. Kay, Kenneth Biller, Jeri Taylor
Summary: Voyager encounters a swarm of spaceborne aliens, while Kes and Neelix must decide whether to have a child.

Name: "Non Sequitur"
Summary: Harry Kim is placed in an alternate timeline where he was never assigned to Voyager.

Name: "Twisted"
Writer(s): Arnold Rudnick, Rich Hosek, Kenneth Biller
Summary: Voyager encounters an inversion field which twists and distorts the ship's hull.

Name: "Parturition"
Summary: A trip to "Planet Hell" proves therapeutic for Tom Paris and Neelix.

Name: "Persistence of Vision"
Summary: Voyager crew members experience disturbing and violent hallucinations.

Name: "Tattoo"
Summary: Chakotay investigates mysterious symbols and visions that are remarkably similar to one of his childhood experiences.

Name: "Cold Fire"
Summary: While attempting to make contact with the Caretaker's mate (who may have the ability to send Voyager home), the crew discovers a colony of Ocampa whose representative has an interest in Kes and helping her explore her telepathic powers.

Name: "Maneuvers"
Summary: After Seska steals vital transporter technology from Voyager, Chakotay sets off on his own to recover it.

Name: "Resistance"
Writer(s): Michael Jan Friedman, Kevin J. Ryan, Lisa Klink
Summary: In order to free her imprisoned crewmembers, Captain Janeway accepts the help of a delusional resistance fighter.

Name: "Prototype"
Summary: A sentient robot enlists Torres' help to make it possible for it to construct new members of its race.

Name: "Alliances"
Summary: After continuous Kazon attacks against Voyager cost the lives of several crewmembers and the damage to the ship continues to mount, Janeway seeks an alliance to secure Voyager's passage through the Kazon Collective.

Name: "Threshold"
Summary: A specially-outfitted warp-capable shuttlecraft piloted by Tom Paris successfully reaches Warp 10, breaking the transwarp barrier. But the side effects of breaking the barrier may cost the crew of Voyager their best helmsman.

Name: "Meld"
Summary: Tuvok is plagued by the senselessness of a murder aboard Voyager.

Name: "Dreadnought"
Summary: Voyager encounters Dreadnought, a Cardassian missile that B'Elanna Torres reprogrammed during her time in the Maquis. Even though lost in the Delta Quadrant, the missile still believes it is on a Maquis mission in the Alpha Quadrant, setting an intercept course with an inhabited world.

Name: "Death Wish"
Summary: A member of the Q Continuum comes aboard Voyager, seeking asylum so he can commit suicide. Q arrives onboard to stop him, leaving Captain Janeway to mediate a moral dilemma.

Name: "Lifesigns"
Summary: The Doctor falls in love with a Vidiian patient whose life he saved. Meanwhile, Tom Paris' insubordination starts to go out of control.

Name: "Investigations"
Writer(s): Jeff Schnaufer, Ed Bond, Jeri Taylor
Summary: Neelix searches for a traitor aboard Voyager using his morning news program.

Name: "Deadlock"
Summary: While trying to avoid Vidiian territory, Voyager is nearly destroyed by proton bursts coming from an unknown source.

Name: "Innocence"
Summary: Tuvok is trapped on a moon with a group of alien children who are disappearing, one by one.

Name: "The Thaw"
Summary: The crew attempts to rescue three aliens in stasis from a bizarre computer program that is based on fear.

Name: "Tuvix"
Writer(s): Andrew Shepard Price, Mark Gaberman, Kenneth Biller
Summary: After a transporter malfunction, Tuvok and Neelix are merged into a single being. In the search for a way to restore them to their original forms, a moral dilemma is faced as the new being does not want to be terminated.

Name: "Resolutions"
Summary: Voyager is forced to abandon Captain Janeway and Chakotay when they are infected with a terminal illness. Tuvok leads Voyager on a mission to find a cure.

Name: "Basics, Part I"
Summary: On a mission to rescue Chakotay's son from Maje Culluh, Voyager is captured by the Kazon-Nistrim in a sneak attack.

Name: "Basics, Part II"
Summary: With the Kazon-Nistrim in control of Voyager, the crew must return to basics in order to survive on a harsh world inhabited by alien natives and vicious predators. Meanwhile, Suder and The Doctor assist Paris' attempts to retake Voyager.

Name: "Flashback"
Summary: When Tuvok begins to suffer from a mental breakdown, triggered by a suppressed memory, a mind-meld with Janeway takes him back to his tour of duty with Captain Sulu aboard the USS Excelsior.

Name: "The Chute"
Summary: Harry Kim and Tom Paris are found guilty and detained in a prison where a neural implant gradually drives the inmates mad.

Name: "The Swarm"
Summary: The Doctor suffers from a computer malfunction; Voyager is attacked by a swarm of alien warships.

Name: "False Profits"
Summary: Voyager discovers a pair of Ferengi who control the economy of a primitive world; nearby is an unstable wormhole that leads back home.

Name: "Remember"
Writer(s): Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky, Lisa Klink
Summary: B'Elanna Torres receives vivid dreams from an unknown passenger aboard Voyager.

Name: "Sacred Ground"
Summary: Kes is injured when she accidentally commits sacrilege on an alien planet; in order to save her life, Janeway must go through a mysterious ritual that challenges her faith in science.

Name: "Future's End"
Summary: After encountering a Federation timeship from the future, Voyager is sent back to 20th century Earth.

Name: "Future's End, Part II"
Summary: Janeway tries to prevent Henry Starling from launching the timeship without altering the past.

Name: "Warlord"
Writer(s): Andrew Shepard Price, Mark Gaberman, Lisa Klink
Summary: Kes is taken over by the mind-force of an obsessive rebel.

Name: "The Q and the Grey"
Summary: Q has a novel idea for ending civil war in the Q Continuum: have a child with Captain Janeway.

Name: "Macrocosm"
Summary: When viruses grow to a meter in length and begin attacking the crew of Voyager, Captain Janeway and The Doctor must retake the ship.

Name: "Fair Trade"
Writer(s): Ronald Wilkerson, Jean Louise Matthias, André Bormanis
Summary: A meeting with an old friend lands Neelix in an ever-deepening hole of trouble.

Name: "Alter Ego"
Summary: Tuvok and Harry Kim become interested in a holodeck character who is more than she seems.

Name: "Coda"
Summary: After her apparent death, Captain Janeway's journey to the afterlife, guided by her father, leaves her with suspicions.

Name: "Blood Fever"
Summary: B'Elanna Torres experiences symptoms similar to pon farr after being attacked by Ensign Vorik who is also undergoing the blood fever.

Name: "Unity"
Summary: Chakotay is injured and trapped on a world where the inhabitants are embroiled in conflict, but the people who rescue and care for him harbor a disturbing secret.

Name: "Darkling"
Summary: The Doctor alters his personality subroutines while Kes contemplates leaving Voyager for a man.

Name: "Rise"
Summary: Voyager defends a planet that is being bombarded by asteroids.

Name: "Favorite Son"
Summary: Harry learns both that he is actually a member of a Delta Quadrant race and that his people want him to never leave his new home.

Name: "Before and After"
Summary: Kes finds herself in temporal flux with her consciousness moving back in time through various episodes in her life up until her birth.

Name: "Real Life"
Summary: The Doctor learns a few real life lessons with the holographic "family" he created; Voyager investigates massive subspace distortions.

Name: "Distant Origin"
Summary: An alien scientist finds evidence linking his species' ancestry to Earth, but government officials refuse to accept his evidence because it conflicts with existing doctrine.

Name: "Displaced"
Summary: Voyager crew members begin disappearing one by one, being replaced by aliens.

Name: "Worst Case Scenario"
Summary: A buried holonovel with high entertainment value depicting a Maquis mutiny is discovered.

Name: "Scorpion"
Summary: Upon entering Borg space, Voyager encounters an alien race even more powerful than the Borg and bent on destroying all life in the galaxy, leading Captain Janeway to enter into an alliance with the Borg in order to defeat them.

Name: "Scorpion, Part II"
Summary: Captain Janeway forges a shaky alliance with the Borg Collective to defeat Species 8472, leading to a new potential crewmember coming aboard.

Name: "The Gift"
Summary: Kes's telepathic and latent psychokinetic powers begin to grow rapidly while Voyager's newest crewmember, the former Borg drone Seven of Nine, deals with her new individuality.

Name: "Day of Honor"
Summary: Lieutenants B'Elanna Torres and Tom Paris admit feelings for each other while close to death; a race of homeless aliens ask for Voyager's help but are not quite satisfied with what they receive.

Name: "Nemesis"
Summary: Chakotay is trapped on a planet where two species are fighting a genocidal war against each other.

Name: "Revulsion"
Summary: The Doctor meets another sentient hologram, and tries to help the troubled program with his problems.

Name: "The Raven"
Summary: Seven of Nine experiences flashbacks, and believes that she is being called back to the Borg Collective.

Name: "Scientific Method"
Writer(s): Lisa Klink, Sherry Klein, Harry Kloor
Summary: A group of aliens perform experiments on the crew without their knowledge.

Name: "Year of Hell"
Summary: Obsessed with restoring the Krenim Imperium, no matter the cost, a Krenim military temporal scientist creates changes in history that all but destroy Voyager.

Name: "Year of Hell, Part II"
Summary: With Voyager almost destroyed, Captain Janeway risks everything to rescue Paris and Chakotay, and stop Annorax from continuing to tamper with the timeline.

Name: "Random Thoughts"
Summary: B'Elanna Torres is imprisoned for having violent thoughts on a planet of peaceful telepaths.

Name: "Concerning Flight"
Summary: When pirates steal the ship's main computer and other critical equipment, Captain Janeway tries to track down the missing equipment with the help of the holographic Leonardo da Vinci.

Name: "Mortal Coil"
Summary: After being killed on an away mission and then revived by Seven's Borg nanoprobes, Neelix finds himself in a deep existential and spiritual crisis, questioning his faith and the meaning of his existence.

Name: "Waking Moments"
Summary: The crew begins to experience vivid nightmares, all containing the same mysterious alien.

Name: "Message in a Bottle"
Summary: Seven of Nine finds an abandoned subspace relay network that has the ability to send a message, or in this case The Doctor, to a Starfleet ship detected in the Alpha Quadrant.

Name: "Hunters"
Summary: Voyager receives a message from Starfleet containing letters from the crew's friends and family.

Name: "Prey"
Summary: Voyager rescues a critically injured Hirogen hunter who wishes to finish his hunt against a "resilient species" – a recent enemy of the Voyager crew – as Captain Janeway attempts to give Seven of Nine a lesson in compassion.

Name: "Retrospect"
Writer(s): Bryan Fuller, Lisa Klink, Andrew Shepard Price, Mark Gaberman
Summary: Seven believes that a visiting weapons merchant assaulted her.

Name: "The Killing Game"
Summary: The Hirogen hijack the USS Voyager and force the crew into deadly holodeck simulations with altered personalities to satiate their desire for creative new ways to hunt prey.

Name: "The Killing Game, Part II"
Summary: With half the Voyager crew trapped in a deadly simulation staged by the Hirogen, Captain Janeway must find a way to retake the ship.

Name: "Vis à Vis"
Summary: A genome thief switches physical forms with Tom Paris.

Name: "The Omega Directive"
Writer(s): Lisa Klink, Jimmy Diggs, Steve J. Kay
Summary: Captain Janeway must carry out a top secret Starfleet directive regarding the most powerful and dangerous substance known to exist.

Name: "Unforgettable"
Summary: Chakotay meets a woman who claims that they fell in love a few weeks before, although he doesn't remember her anymore.

Name: "Living Witness"
Writer(s): Bryan Fuller, Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky
Summary: Reactivated after lying inactive for seven hundred years, a backup version of The Doctor tries to uncover the truth about war crimes supposedly committed by Voyager when they passed a planet centuries ago.

Name: "Demon"
Summary: Voyager, desperately low on fuel, finds deuterium on a highly hostile "Demon class" planet.

Name: "One"
Summary: After the rest of the crew is placed in suspended animation to protect them from dangerous radiation, the immune Seven, with only The Doctor for company, is placed in control of the ship.

Name: "Hope and Fear"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky
Summary: Finally decoding the message from Starfleet they received months earlier, Voyager is directed to a nearby sector where an unmanned Federation starship waits for them. However, everything is not what it seems when alien technology is found aboard the new ship.

Name: "Night"
Summary: Voyager enters a vast region of space with no stars or systems. As the crew tries to find a way to pass time in this desolate part of space, Janeway bitterly reflects on her decision that stranded them in the Delta Quadrant.

Name: "Drone"
Writer(s): Bryan Fuller, Harry Kloor, Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky
Summary: A transporter accident involving The Doctor's mobile emitter and Seven's nanoprobes results in the creation of a 29th century Borg.

Name: "Extreme Risk"
Summary: The crew races to build a new shuttle, designed by Tom Paris, in order to retrieve a multi-spatial probe trapped inside a gas giant. Meanwhile, B'Elanna Torres' attitude worries the crew.

Name: "In the Flesh"
Summary: Voyager finds a station containing a disturbingly accurate re-creation of Starfleet Command and Starfleet Academy constructed by Species 8472.

Name: "Once Upon a Time"
Summary: Neelix tries to take care of young Naomi Wildman whose mother was aboard the Delta Flyer when it crashed into a planet during an ion storm.

Name: "Timeless"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky
Summary: A failed attempt to return home results in Voyager crash-landing on an ice world and also in the deaths of the crew, except Chakotay and Harry Kim. Now, fifteen years later, the two men, having resigned from Starfleet, attempt to alter history to save the ship from disaster before Starfleet can stop them.

Name: "Infinite Regress"
Summary: Seven of Nine begins exhibiting the personalities of people that she assimilated as a member of the collective.

Name: "Nothing Human"
Summary: When an injured, non-humanoid alien attaches itself to Lt. Torres, a hologram of a notorious Cardassian exobiologist is created to help The Doctor remove it from her.

Name: "Thirty Days"
Summary: Tom Paris is demoted to ensign and is sentenced to thirty days in the brig for disobeying orders. While serving time in the brig, Tom writes a letter to his father about the events that led to his demotion.

Name: "Counterpoint"
Summary: Voyager smuggles telepathic refugees through Devore space.

Name: "Latent Image"
Writer(s): Eileen Connors, Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky
Summary: When The Doctor discovers evidence that his memory files may have been tampered with, it sets in motion a chain of events that lead to the recollection of the death of a crew member, one The Doctor believes he was responsible for.

Name: "Bride of Chaotica!"
Summary: Trans-dimensional photonic lifeforms on an exploratory mission become entangled in a war with the characters from Tom Paris' "Captain Proton" program after mistaking Voyager's holodeck for reality.

Name: "Gravity"
Writer(s): Jimmy Diggs, Bryan Fuller, Nick Sagan
Summary: A Voyager shuttle crashes on a deserted planet within a temporally-distorted area of space, stranding Tom Paris, Tuvok, and The Doctor with an alien woman who falls in love with Tuvok.

Name: "Bliss"
Summary: Voyager finds a wormhole that leads directly back to Earth, but Seven of Nine suspects that it may not be what it appears.

Name: "Dark Frontier"
Summary: When Captain Janeway devises a plan to steal a transwarp coil from a damaged Borg sphere, the mysterious Borg Queen learns of the plan and uses this knowledge in an attempt to return Seven of Nine to the Borg by issuing her an ultimatum: rejoin the Collective or watch as Voyager is assimilated.

Name: "The Disease"
Summary: Harry Kim breaks Starfleet regulations when he falls in love with an alien woman.

Name: "Course: Oblivion"
Summary: As Voyager crewmembers begin dying, they make a startling discovery about their true identities.

Name: "The Fight"
Summary: When Voyager is caught in "chaotic space," an area where the laws of physics are in a state of flux, Chakotay begins hearing and seeing things, apparently caused by the aliens living inside it who are trying to contact the ship.

Name: "Think Tank"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Michael Taylor
Summary: A group of extremely intelligent aliens offers to help Voyager escape from a race of bounty hunters known as the Hazari, in exchange for Seven of Nine.

Name: "Juggernaut"
Writer(s): Bryan Fuller, Nick Sagan, Kenneth Biller
Summary: Voyager finds a damaged Malon freighter that is about to explode and contaminate an entire sector with deadly radiation.

Name: "Someone to Watch Over Me"
Summary: The Doctor teaches Seven about dating and romantic relationships, but then realizes that he may have developed feelings for her himself.
Kathryn Janeway discovers the truth about one of her famed ancestors, Shannon O'Donnel, realizing that who Shannon was differs vastly from what Janeway had believed all her life.

Name: "Relativity"
Writer(s): Bryan Fuller, Nick Sagan, Michael Taylor
Summary: Seven of Nine is recruited by a starship from the 29th century to save Voyager from being destroyed in the past.

Name: "Warhead"
Writer(s): Brannon Braga, Michael Taylor, Kenneth Biller
Summary: A sentient alien missile takes over The Doctor's program and tries to carry out its mission of mass destruction.

Name: "Equinox"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky
Summary: Voyager finds another Federation starship, the USS Equinox, stranded in the Delta Quadrant. But they also find that the Equinox crew is harboring a dark secret.

Name: "Equinox, Part II"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky
Summary: Captain Janeway takes her quest for revenge against Captain Ransom to extremes when she orders the use of photon torpedoes against the Equinox, tractors a neutral ship, nearly kills an Equinox crewman during an interrogation, and relieves Chakotay of duty when he questions her actions.

Name: "Survival Instinct"
Summary: Seven encounters three ex-Borg with whom she had been temporarily separated from the Collective eight years previously.

Name: "Barge of the Dead"
Summary: B'Elanna Torres dies in a shuttle accident, and finds herself headed for Gre'thor, the afterlife for dishonored Klingons.

Name: "Tinker Tenor Doctor Spy"
Summary: Aliens attempt to spy on Voyager by tapping into The Doctor's program, but they mistakenly access his new "daydream" program and believe that to be the reality.

Name: "Alice"
Writer(s): Juliann deLayne, Bryan Fuller, Michael Taylor
Summary: Paris is manipulated by the intelligence on board a mysterious alien shuttle recently acquired from an interstellar junkyard.

Name: "Riddles"
Summary: Tuvok loses his memory along with his Vulcan emotional self-control when he is attacked by mysterious aliens.

Name: "Dragon's Teeth"
Writer(s): Michael Taylor, Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky
Summary: When Voyager seeks refuge from alien attackers on the surface of a devastated planet, they find a small group of people who have survived in suspended animation for almost nine hundred years.

Name: "One Small Step"
Writer(s): Mike Wollaeger, Jessica Scott, Bryan Fuller, Michael Taylor
Summary: Voyager finds an ancient spacecraft – the derelict of one of Humanity's first manned missions to Mars.

Name: "The Voyager Conspiracy"
Summary: Seven investigates a massive "conspiracy" involving the Federation, the Cardassians, the Caretaker, and numerous other alien races, which indicates that Voyager was deliberately stranded in the Delta Quadrant.

Name: "Pathfinder"
Summary: When the Enterprise-E returns home to Earth, Lieutenant Barclay seeks Counselor Deanna Troi's help when he worries that he has become obsessed with the crew of Voyager.

Name: "Fair Haven"
Summary: The crew relaxes in Paris's latest holodeck creation: an idealized 19th century Irish village, where Captain Janeway falls in love with a holographic character.

Name: "Blink of an Eye"
Summary: Over time and generations, a world tries to uncover the mystery of a strange object in the sky.

Name: "Virtuoso"
Summary: The Doctor becomes a celebrity among a race that has not developed music.

Name: "Memorial"
Summary: After returning from an extended away mission, Voyager crewmembers inexplicably begin having horrific flashbacks to an atrocity that they seem to have participated in.

Name: "Tsunkatse"
Summary: Seven of Nine is kidnapped by an opportunistic ringmaster who forces her to participate in a Norcadian blood sport.

Name: "Collective"
Writer(s): Andrew Shepard Price, Mark Gaberman, Michael Taylor
Summary: Voyager finds a Borg cube controlled by assimilated children who have been separated from the Collective mind.

Name: "Spirit Folk"
Summary: The characters in the Fair Haven holoprogram begin to suspect the Voyager crew after they witness several "supernatural" occurrences.

Name: "Ashes to Ashes"
Summary: A long-presumed-dead crewmate returns to Voyager, pursued by the aliens who revived her; Icheb, Azan, Rebi, and Mezoti behave rebelliously against Seven of Nine.

Name: "Child's Play"
Summary: Icheb's return to his home planet after his abduction by the Borg is difficult for Seven to bear when her awakening maternal instincts make her suspicious of his parents.

Name: "Good Shepherd"
Summary: When three crewmen are shown to be hampering efficiency, Captain Janeway decides to give them some special attention by taking them on an away mission.

Name: "Live Fast and Prosper"
Summary: A trio of con artists impersonate Captain Janeway, Tuvok, and Chakotay to try to scam money and resources out of unsuspecting victims.

Name: "Muse"
Summary: Torres is stranded on a pre-industrial planet where she becomes the inspiration for a local poet.

Name: "Fury"
Writer(s): Bryan Fuller, Michael Taylor, Rick Berman, Brannon Braga
Summary: Kes returns, seeking revenge on both Voyager and Janeway.

Name: "Life Line"
Writer(s): Robert Doherty, Raf Green, Brannon Braga,  John Bruno, Robert Picardo
Summary: The Doctor is sent to the Alpha Quadrant to cure the dying creator of his program, Lewis Zimmerman, but the holographic engineer wants no part of him.

Name: "The Haunting of Deck Twelve"
Writer(s): Mike Sussman, Kenneth Biller, Bryan Fuller
Summary: While the USS Voyager is without power for several hours, Neelix tells the children a ghost story of the events that lead up to it... or is it more than just a story?

Name: "Unimatrix Zero"
Writer(s): Mike Sussman, Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky
Summary: Seven is drawn into a virtual reality that some Borg drones inhabit during their regeneration cycles – a threat to the Borg Collective that Janeway wants to exploit.

Name: "Unimatrix Zero, Part II"
Writer(s): Mike Sussman, Brannon Braga, Joe Menosky
Summary: Assimilated by the Borg, Janeway, Torres, and Tuvok plot to release a virus into the Borg Collective which will allow members of Unimatrix Zero to retain their individuality in the real world and resist the Borg Queen.

Name: "Imperfection"
Writer(s): André Bormanis, Carleton Eastlake, Robert Doherty
Summary: Seven's life is put in danger when a crucial Borg implant malfunctions.

Name: "Drive"
Summary: Tom Paris enters the new Delta Flyer in an interstellar starship race.

Name: "Repression"
Summary: Tuvok investigates a series of assaults that are apparently targeted at the former Maquis aboard Voyager.

Name: "Critical Care"
Writer(s): Kenneth Biller, Robert Doherty, James Kahn
Summary: The Doctor's program is taken from Voyager, and he is put to work on a vast hospital ship, where the twisted medical system is based on social status, rather than medical condition.

Name: "Inside Man"
Summary: The Pathfinder Project makes contact with Voyager again… and this time they transmit a hologram designed by Reginald Barclay to interact with the crew. However a certain group of aliens have seen a way to make a tidy profit.

Name: "Body and Soul"
Writer(s): Michael Taylor, Eric A. Morris, Phyllis Strong, Mike Sussman
Summary: When the Delta Flyer is attacked, The Doctor must hide his program in Seven's Borg implants. Meanwhile, Tuvok undergoes the pon farr.

Name: "Nightingale"
Writer(s): Robert Lederman, Dave Long, André Bormanis
Summary: When Harry Kim rescues a crippled alien starship, the grateful crew offers him command. Meanwhile on Voyager, Icheb believes B'Elanna Torres has become attracted to him.

Name: "Flesh and Blood"
Writer(s): Jack Monaco, Bryan Fuller, Raf Green
Summary: Voyager answers a distress call from a Hirogen outpost – only to find carnage caused by holographic technology that Captain Janeway has given them.

Name: "Shattered"
Summary: The macroviruses, Dr. Chaotica, and Seska hinder Chakotay and Janeway's attempt to restore Voyager to its normal state after a temporal distortion shifts sections of the ship into different timeframes.

Name: "Lineage"
Summary: Torres discovers that she is pregnant, and faces a private fear that she has had to deal with since her childhood.

Name: "Repentance"
Summary: After Voyager rescues the crew of a severely damaged alien vessel carrying convicts to their executions, the crew begins to question the aliens' legal system.

Name: "Prophecy"
Writer(s): Larry Nemecek, J. Kelley Burke, Raf Green, Kenneth Biller, Mike Sussman, Phyllis Strong
Summary: Voyager becomes a battleground for the descendants of a group of Klingon pilgrims, some of whom believe that B'Elanna Torres's child is their savior.

Name: "The Void"
Writer(s): Raf Green, Kenneth Biller, James Kahn
Summary: Voyager becomes trapped in an empty region of space where other stranded starships prey on each other to survive.

Name: "Workforce"
Summary: Most of the Voyager crew is kidnapped and forced to labor in a massive industrial work force.

Name: "Workforce, Part II"
Writer(s): Kenneth Biller, Bryan Fuller, Michael Taylor
Summary: Quarren forces close in as Chakotay and the others try to rescue the crew.

Name: "Human Error"
Writer(s): André Bormanis, Kenneth Biller, Brannon Braga
Summary: When Seven tries to perfect her social skills on the holodeck, her new emotions soon overwhelm her Borg implants. Meanwhile, Voyager accidentally wanders into an interstellar firing range.

Name: "Q2"
Summary: Facing his son's banishment from the Q Continuum, Q leaves him on Voyager in the hopes that he will gain self-discipline.

Name: "Author, Author"
Writer(s): Brannon Braga, Phyllis Strong, Mike Sussman
Summary: The Doctor completes work on a holonovel that depicts the crew of Voyager in rather unflattering roles as they abuse and scorn the Emergency Medical Hologram. When the holonovel is published without his permission, the issue of The Doctor's legal rights is brought into question. Seven reconnects with her aunt.

Name: "Friendship One"
Summary: Starfleet Command sends Voyager on a special mission to retrieve a 21st century Earth probe which is believed lost in the Delta Quadrant.

Name: "Natural Law"
Summary: En route to a scientific conference on Ledos, Chakotay and Seven's shuttle is driven out of control by a force field layer over a wilderness area. Meanwhile, Paris gets a speeding ticket in the Delta Flyer, and is sentenced to a three-day safety course.

Name: "Homestead"
Summary: Neelix is reunited with his people as he tries to save an imperiled Talaxian settlement.

Name: "Renaissance Man"
Writer(s): Andrew Shepard Price, Mark Gaberman, Phyllis Strong, Mike Sussman
Summary: The Doctor must become a master of disguise to save Captain Janeway.

Name: "Endgame"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Kenneth Biller, Brannon Braga, Robert Doherty
Summary: Years after Voyager's return to the Alpha Quadrant, Admiral Kathryn Janeway resolves to alter the past in order to help her crew get home sooner.

Name: "Broken Bow"
Summary: Earth launches its first starship of exploration, Enterprise, on a mission to return an injured Klingon to his homeworld.

Name: "Fight or Flight"
Summary: Enterprise finds an abandoned ship, filled with corpses which appear to have been used for an experiment.

Name: "Strange New World"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Mike Sussman, Phyllis Strong
Summary: An Enterprise landing party believes T'Pol is conspiring with a species of rock creatures on a strange class M planet.

Name: "Unexpected"
Summary: When Trip Tucker assists an alien vessel with repairs, a "friendly" encounter with one of the crew leads to rather unexpected consequences.

Name: "Terra Nova"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Antoinette Stella
Summary: Enterprise investigates the mystery of a lost Earth colony whose inhabitants disappeared decades before. But that doesn't mean they left.

Name: "The Andorian Incident"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Fred Dekker
Summary: Enterprise visits a Vulcan monastery, only to find that it is in the midst of being taken over by the Andorians.

Name: "Breaking the Ice"
Summary: With a Vulcan ship on their tail, Enterprise decides to investigate a comet.

Name: "Civilization"
Summary: Enterprise finds a fully inhabited Earth-like planet, where some of the inhabitants are suffering from a mysterious disease.

Name: "Fortunate Son"
Summary: Enterprise is sent to assist the Fortunate, an Earth freighter that has been attacked by Nausicaan pirates. But the Fortunate may not be as innocent as it seems.

Name: "Cold Front"
Summary: Archer is confronted by a member of his crew who claims to be from nine hundred years in the future – and is there to capture a Suliban operative who has boarded Enterprise.

Name: "Silent Enemy"
Summary: Enterprise is attacked by an unknown alien starship, as Archer orders the crew to install experimental "phase cannons". Meanwhile, Sato is ordered to find out what Reed's favorite food is for a birthday dinner.

Name: "Dear Doctor"
Summary: Enterprise assists a culture that has been stricken by a planet-wide plague.

Name: "Sleeping Dogs"
Summary: While exploring a gas giant, Enterprise finds the wreck of a Klingon scout vessel sinking into the atmosphere.

Name: "Shadows of P'Jem"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Mike Sussman, Phyllis Strong
Summary: Archer and T'Pol are taken prisoner during an away mission on a war-torn planet in the Coridan system.

Name: "Shuttlepod One"
Summary: While investigating an asteroid field, Tucker and Reed are convinced that Enterprise has been destroyed and try to face their own oncoming deaths.

Name: "Fusion"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Mike Sussman, Phyllis Strong
Summary: The crew of Enterprise meets a group of outcast Vulcans, who embrace their own emotions, leading to trouble for T'Pol.

Name: "Rogue Planet"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Chris Black
Summary: Archer has visions of a mysterious humanoid woman on a rogue planet where it is eternally nighttime.

Name: "Acquisition"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Maria Jacquemetton, Andre Jacquemetton
Summary: A group of interstellar thieves stun the Enterprise crew and begin looting the ship. Trip Tucker is the only one left to stop them, but can he do that in his underwear?

Name: "Oasis"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Stephen Beck
Summary: The crew finds a derelict spaceship from which they can salvage some supplies… only they find that the ship is not quite as deserted as they were led to believe.

Name: "Detained"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Phyllis Strong, Mike Sussman
Summary: Archer and Mayweather accidentally enter a militarized zone and are detained by an alien race called Tandarans, who are at war with the Suliban. Both men find themselves sharing cells with some Suliban detainees who they believe are wrongly imprisoned.

Name: "Vox Sola"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Fred Dekker
Summary: A symbiotic alien comes aboard Enterprise and captures several of the starship's officers in its web. Hoshi struggles to communicate with the alien invader in an attempt to save the trapped officers.

Name: "Fallen Hero"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Chris Black, Alan Cross
Summary: Archer is ordered to transport Vulcan Ambassador V'Lar from the planet Mazar, where she has been accused of criminal misconduct. Following an attack on Enterprise, T'Pol defends the Ambassador and asks Archer for help.

Name: "Desert Crossing"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, André Bormanis
Summary: Archer and Tucker are invited to a desert-like planet by an alien leader after they help fix his ship. After arriving, they discover he has invited them under false pretenses.

Name: "Two Days and Two Nights"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Chris Black
Summary: The crew takes shore leave on the famous pleasure planet of Risa. For many, it is anything but a vacation.

Name: "Shockwave"
Summary: After apparently causing the destruction of an alien colony, the Enterprise is called back to Earth. Archer learns via Daniels that the Suliban are trying to sabotage Enterprise's mission.

Name: "Shockwave, Part II"
Summary: As the Suliban take the crew hostage, Archer disappears off the ship. While stuck in the 31st century, Archer and Daniels work to find a way to get back to Enterprise and repair the timeline.

Name: "Carbon Creek"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Dan O'Shannon, Chris Black
Summary: T'Pol tells Archer and Tucker a story about her great-grandmother and two other Vulcans, who crash landed in a small Pennsylvania town in the year 1957.

Name: "Minefield"
Summary: Enterprise strays into a Romulan minefield and is disabled by a cloaked mine. While deactivating another mine, Reed gets pinned to the ship's hull.

Name: "Dead Stop"
Summary: Enterprise docks with a strange, automated repair space station, which proves too good to be true.

Name: "A Night In Sickbay"
Summary: Archer spends a night in sickbay after Porthos falls ill with a deadly virus following a visit to an alien planet.

Name: "Marauders"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, David Wilcox
Summary: Enterprise discovers a deuterium mining colony that is being controlled by Klingon marauders. The crew trains the colonists to defend themselves and prepare for battle against their Klingon oppressors.

Name: "The Seventh"
Summary: T'Pol asks Archer to accompany her on a top secret mission to capture a fugitive that has eluded the Vulcan High Command for two decades.

Name: "The Communicator"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, André Bormanis
Summary: During an investigation of a pre-warp alien planet, Reed accidentally leaves his communicator behind. When he returns with Archer to get the piece of technology, they are captured by soldiers who accuse them of being enemy spies.

Name: "Singularity"
Summary: Upon approaching a black hole, the crew starts exhibiting strange behavior and uncharacteristically obsesses over trivial matters.

Name: "Vanishing Point"
Summary: Following her first experience with the transporter, an eerie series of events makes Hoshi think she is becoming invisible to the rest of the crew.

Name: "Precious Cargo"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, David A. Goodman
Summary: After Enterprise rescues a pair of aliens with a mysterious cargo, Trip finds himself in a major predicament after he accidentally opens the cargo.

Name: "The Catwalk"
Summary: When a deadly neutronic storm threatens the ship, the crew must take refuge for eight days inside the maintenance shafts of the warp nacelles.

Name: "Dawn"
Summary: While in a shuttlepod performing tests, Tucker is attacked by a hostile alien and forced to crash-land on a desolate moon.

Name: "Stigma"
Summary: T'Pol's position on Enterprise is jeopardized when the Vulcans discover that she has contracted a mind-affecting disease. Meanwhile, one of Phlox's wives comes aboard and expresses a romantic interest in Tucker, much to his discomfort.

Name: "Cease Fire"
Summary: Archer is called in to mediate a territorial dispute between the Vulcans and the Andorians.

Name: "Future Tense"
Summary: Enterprise finds a small craft – apparently from the future – adrift in space, and both the Suliban and the mysterious Tholians are intent on retrieving it.

Name: "Canamar"
Summary: Archer and Tucker are mistakenly arrested and placed on a prison ship bound for the infamous penal colony of Canamar.

Name: "The Crossing"
Writer(s): André Bormanis, Rick Berman, Brannon Braga
Summary: Enterprise is captured by a ship of non-corporeal beings who wish to trade consciousnesses with the crew's bodies. But these "wisps" may not plan on giving the bodies back...

Name: "Judgment"
Summary: Archer is charged by a Klingon tribunal for helping rebels try to escape the Empire.

Name: "Horizon"
Summary: While Enterprise diverts to observe an unusual planetary event, Travis Mayweather takes time off to visit his family on the cargo ship where he was born and raised, the Horizon.

Name: "The Breach"
Writer(s): Daniel McCarthy, Chris Black, John Shiban
Summary: While Enterprise rescues three Denobulan scientists from a planet under a new xenophobic government, Dr. Phlox must treat a patient with racist views against his people.

Name: "Cogenitor"
Summary: Enterprise encounters the Vissians, a race that includes a third gender of "cogenitors" who are treated as second-class citizens.

Name: "Regeneration"
Summary: A scientific team in the Arctic discovers a crashed derelict ship and two cybernetic alien bodies from over a hundred years earlier. When the aliens revive themselves, they kidnap the scientists, hijack their vessel and move out into space where Enterprise must confront them.

Name: "First Flight"
Summary: When he is told of the death of an old rival, Archer reflects on his days in the NX test program.

Name: "Bounty"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Hans Tobeason, Mike Sussman, Phyllis Strong
Summary: Archer is captured by a Tellarite bounty hunter who plans to hand him over to the Klingons; a microbe induces the pon farr in T'Pol who finds herself confined to the decon chamber with Phlox.

Name: "The Expanse"
Summary: After a devastating attack on Earth by an alien probe of unknown origin, Enterprise is recalled and sent into a strange expanse on a new, more vital mission.

Name: "The Xindi"
Summary: Six weeks into the Delphic Expanse, the crew is tipped off by a freighter captain who knows a lone Xindi working on a remote mining colony.

Name: "Anomaly (ENT)"
Summary: Enterprise is damaged by spatial anomalies and boarded by interstellar pirates who rob the ship of critical resources.

Name: "Extinction"
Summary: Archer, Reed, and Sato are threatened by a virus that mutates them into a primal lifeform.

Name: "Rajiin"
Writer(s): Paul Brown, Brent V. Friedman, Chris Black
Summary: Enterprise takes on board Rajiin: a beautiful, enigmatic passenger with ulterior motives.

Name: "Impulse"
Summary: After finding the drifting hull of a Vulcan cruiser inside an asteroid field, Captain Archer and his crew are surprised to find Vulcans "alive" on it. When they are stranded there, they must find out what happened to the crew before T'Pol succumbs to the same fate.

Name: "Exile"
Summary: Hoshi is contacted by a mysterious telepath, who offers to help Enterprise in its mission... for a price.

Name: "The Shipment"
Summary: Enterprise discovers a Xindi mining outpost where components of the Xindi weapon are being assembled.

Name: "Twilight"
Summary: The effect of a Delphic Expanse anomaly leaves Archer unable to form any new long-term memories. Twelve years later, he wakes up one morning and is stunned to learn the outcome of the Human-Xindi conflict, including the loss of Earth, and the near-annihilation of the Human race.

Name: "North Star"
Summary: Archer and the crew try to discover why a 19th century-era Human settlement has been placed in the middle of the Expanse.

Name: "Similitude"
Summary: During an engine performance test, Trip Tucker is critically injured and left comatose in sickbay. Phlox suggests that Tucker's only hope for survival is the creation of a "mimetic simbiot" – in other words, a clone. The crew and Trip's clone have to face the unforeseen emotional ramifications of his creation.

Name: "Carpenter Street"
Summary: Daniels sends Archer and T'Pol to 2004 Detroit to follow three Xindi-Reptilians who are creating a biological weapon.

Name: "Chosen Realm"
Summary: Enterprise is hijacked by a group of religious extremists who worship the mysterious spheres in the Expanse.

Name: "Proving Ground"
Summary: An Andorian ship commanded by Shran unexpectedly appears in the Expanse to help the Enterprise locate the Xindi primary weapon.

Name: "Stratagem"
Summary: Enterprise captures Degra, the mastermind behind the Xindi weapon project, and Archer tries to trick him into revealing the location of the final weapon.

Name: "Harbinger"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Manny Coto
Summary: Enterprise rescues an alien from a massive spatial anomaly, but its lone pilot refuses to explain why he was there. Reed and Hayes confront each other over their roles on the ship.

Name: "Doctor's Orders"
Summary: In order to traverse a trans-dimensional disturbance safely, Phlox must put the rest of the crew in stasis and pilot Enterprise himself.

Name: "Hatchery"
Summary: Enterprise finds a derelict Xindi-Insectoid starship carrying a cache of unhatched eggs and Archer takes an increasingly obsessive interest in preserving them.

Name: "Azati Prime"
Writer(s): Rick Berman, Brannon Braga, Manny Coto
Summary: The crew discovers the Xindi weapon and plans to launch a suicide mission to destroy it, with Archer insisting that he be at the helm. But, when Archer is captured, he must convince Degra and the other Xindi leaders, that Humanity is no threat to the Xindi. Meanwhile, the Xindi launch a heavy attack on Enterprise that leaves the ship defenseless and almost destroyed.

Name: "Damage"
Summary: The Enterprise crew must cope with devastating damage to the ship, with another alien ship needing assistance nearby. T'Pol seeks help from Phlox with a personal problem, and dissent grows in the Xindi Council.

Name: "The Forgotten"
Summary: Two members of the Xindi Council offer to stop the launch of the weapon if Archer can prove that the Xindi have been manipulated; the crew holds a memorial for their dead shipmates.

Name: "E²"
Summary: An accident during an attempt to use a Xindi subspace corridor places the Enterprise in a bizarre confrontation... with itself.

Name: "The Council"
Summary: Archer confronts the Xindi Council.

Name: "Countdown"
Summary: With help from some Xindi factions, the Enterprise crew attempts to stop the arming of the Xindi weapon.

Name: "Zero Hour"
Summary: With the weapon on its way to Earth, Archer leads a small team to intercept it before it can strike; T'Pol leads Enterprise on a mission to destroy one of the spheres in the Expanse.

Name: "Storm Front"
Summary: Archer and his crew find themselves in Earth's past, with events of World War II altered by the Temporal Cold War.

Name: "Storm Front, Part II"
Summary: With the unlikely help of Silik, Archer closes in on the temporal operative whose actions have altered Earth's past and threatened to destroy all of time.

Name: "Home"
Summary: Once Enterprise finally returns to Earth, the weary crew face repercussions from their journeys, both positive and negative.

Name: "Borderland"
Summary: Archer needs the help of a criminal to prevent war with the Klingons.

Name: "Cold Station 12"
Summary: Soong's Augments take control of a medical facility containing more augment embryos and several dangerous diseases.

Name: "The Augments"
Summary: Dr. Soong's Augments acquire additional Augment embryos as well as biological weapons from Cold Station 12. A desperate plan is devised to use the biological weapons to foment a war between the Klingons and Earth in an attempt to flee Earth's control forever.

Name: "The Forge"
Summary: When Earth's embassy on Vulcan is bombed, the investigation puts Archer and T'Pol on the trail of a Vulcan religious faction hiding in a treacherous desert.

Name: "Awakening"
Summary: Archer and T'Pol encounter the Syrrannites, the radical group supposedly responsible for a terrorist bombing on Vulcan.

Name: "Kir'Shara"
Summary: Archer and T'Pol endeavor to expose an ancient Vulcan artifact to Vulcan society, while Enterprise becomes involved in a standoff between the Vulcan and Andorian fleets.

Name: "Daedalus"
Summary: The inventor of Earth's transporter comes aboard Enterprise for an experiment.

Name: "Observer Effect"
Summary: A pair of non-physical Organians study the response of the Enterprise crew to the infection of Hoshi Sato and Tucker by a fatal silicon-based virus brought on board during an away mission.

Name: "Babel One"
Summary: Enterprise journeys to Babel with a Tellarite ambassador on board for peace talks with the Andorians, when a distress call from Shran is received.

Name: "United"
Writer(s): Manny Coto, Judith Reeves-Stevens, Garfield Reeves-Stevens
Summary: Archer tries to unify the Andorians, Tellarites, Humans, and Vulcans in a plan to capture a marauder ship threatening to destabilize the region.

Name: "The Aenar"
Summary: Archer visits Shran's icy homeworld to find an Andorian subspecies called the Aenar, to determine their connection to the marauders destroying ships in the region.

Name: "Affliction"
Summary: While Enterprise visits Earth for the launch of Columbia, Phlox is kidnapped and forced to help the Klingons deal with a grave threat toward their species.

Name: "Divergence"
Summary: With Columbia's help, the Enterprise crew grapples with sabotage to their ship as they pursue the truth behind the kidnapping of Phlox.

Name: "Bound"
Summary: While T'Pol and Tucker discover that they have developed a psychic bond, Captain Archer receives three Orion slave girls as a gift for negotiating with the devious Orion Syndicate – with rather disastrous results.

Name: "In A Mirror, Darkly"
Summary: In the mirror universe, Commander Archer mutinies against Captain Forrest in order to capture a future Earth ship found in Tholian space.

Name: "In A Mirror, Darkly, Part II"
Summary: In the mirror universe, the destruction of Enterprise leaves the crew stranded aboard the USS Defiant, a ship from a future parallel universe where a governing body known as the United Federation of Planets reigns, inspiring T'Pol to speak out against the tyranny of the Terran Empire.

Name: "Demons"
Summary: A xenophobic faction of Humanity threatens to undermine talks to form a new coalition of planets.

Name: "Terra Prime"
Writer(s): André Bormanis, Judith Reeves-Stevens, Garfield Reeves-Stevens, Manny Coto
Summary: A Human isolationist leader threatens to destroy Starfleet Command unless all aliens leave the Sol system immediately.

Name: "These Are The Voyages..."
Summary: In hopes of receiving some help before making a difficult personal decision, Commander William T. Riker of the Enterprise-D observes a holodeck simulation of the final mission of the original starship Enterprise, as commanded by Jonathan Archer, in the days immediately preceding the birth of the United Federation of Planets over two centuries earlier.

Name: "The Vulcan Hello"
Writer(s): Bryan Fuller, Alex Kurtzman, Akiva Goldsman, Bryan Fuller
Summary: While patrolling Federation space, the USS Shenzhou encounters an object of unknown origin, putting First Officer Michael Burnham to her greatest test yet.

Name: "Battle at the Binary Stars"
Writer(s): Bryan Fuller, Gretchen J. Berg, Aaron Harberts
Summary: Face to face with Klingon vessels, the USS Shenzhou prepares for the possibility of war if negotiations fail. Amidst the turmoil, Burnham looks back to her Vulcan upbringing for guidance.

Name: "Context Is for Kings"
Writer(s): Bryan Fuller, Gretchen J. Berg, Aaron Harberts, Craig Sweeny
Summary: Michael Burnham finds herself aboard the USS Discovery, where she quickly realizes things are not as they seem, including the mysterious Captain Gabriel Lorca.

Name: "The Butcher's Knife Cares Not for the Lamb's Cry"
Summary: With tensions and stakes high as Starfleet continues in their efforts to end the war with the Klingons, Burnham begins to settle into her new position aboard the USS Discovery.

Name: "Choose Your Pain"
Writer(s): Gretchen J. Berg, Aaron Harberts, Kemp Powers
Summary: While on a mission, Lorca unexpectedly finds himself in the company of prisoner of war Starfleet Lieutenant Ash Tyler and notorious criminal Harry Mudd. Burnham voices her concerns about the repercussions of the spore drive jumps on "Ripper".

Name: "Lethe"
Summary: The USS Discovery crew is intrigued by new addition Lieutenant Ash Tyler. Sarek seeks Burnham's help, rekindling memories from her past. Admiral Cornwell questions Lorca's tactics.

Name: "Magic to Make the Sanest Man Go Mad"
Summary: As the crew attempts to let loose at a party, Harry Mudd triggers a time loop that repeatedly destroys the ship and kills the crew in an effort to learn the secret of the spore drive and sell the Discovery to the Klingons.

Name: "Si Vis Pacem, Para Bellum"
Summary: The USS Discovery is tasked with a high priority mission to planet Pahvo and learn the science behind the Klingons' cloaking technology.

Name: "Into the Forest I Go"
Summary: Disobeying Starfleet's orders, Lorca plans to use the spore drive to discover the secret of the Klingons' cloaking device, destroy the Sarcophagus and lead the Federation to victory.

Name: "Despite Yourself"
Summary: With the Discovery's spore drive taking them into the mirror universe and Lieutenant Stamets completely incapacitated, the crew discovers the horrors of the Terran Empire and must masquerade as their counterparts to find a way home. Lieutenant Tyler discovers there may be more to his post-traumatic stress disorder than just remembering torture at the hands of the Klingons.

Name: "The Wolf Inside"
Summary: Still stranded in the mirror universe, Burnham must try to save the lives of a group of rebels whom she is ordered to destroy by the Terran Empire while maintaining her cover as her counterpart. Meanwhile, a growing terror within Lieutenant Tyler consumes him and threatens the chances of the Discovery returning home.

Name: "Vaulting Ambition"
Summary: Burnham heads to the ISS Charon with a special "gift" for Emperor Georgiou. Back on-board the Discovery, Stamets gains clarity while trapped inside the mycelial network with his Terran counterpart and Saru asks for L'Rell's help to deal with Tyler.

Name: "What's Past Is Prologue"
Summary: Lorca plans to move forward with a coup against the Emperor, propelling Burnham to make a quick decision to save not only herself, but the USS Discovery.

Name: "The War Without, The War Within"
Summary: Michael Burnham and the USS Discovery crew are faced with the war that has been ongoing during their absence. Starfleet tries to think outside of the norm for their next tactics and actions in the fight with the Klingons.

Name: "Will You Take My Hand?"
Writer(s): Akiva Goldsman, Gretchen J. Berg, Aaron Harberts
Summary: With Mirror Georgiou at the helm of the plan to end the Klingon war once and for all, the USS Discovery crew struggles to fathom and tolerate her hostile tactics. Memories of past hardships are rekindled within Burnham.

Name: "Brother"
Writer(s): Ted Sullivan, Gretchen J. Berg, Aaron Harberts
Summary: After answering a distress signal from the USS Enterprise, the USS Discovery welcomes aboard Captain Christopher Pike and begins a new mission to investigate the meaning behind seven mysterious red signals. Michael Burnham grapples with her past growing up on Vulcan with her foster parents and brother Spock.

Name: "New Eden"
Writer(s): Akiva Goldsman, Sean Cochran, Vaun Wilmott
Summary: A new signal appears, prompting Stamets' emotional return to the mycelial network and leading Burnham, Pike, and Owosekun to a pre-warp planet, where they face a complex ethical dilemma. Tilly's over-eagerness lands her in trouble but when the planet – and Discovery's landing party – are threatened, her curiosity may be the one thing that can save them.

Name: "Point of Light"
Summary: A surprise visitor to the USS Discovery brings shocking news about Spock and dredges up past regrets for Burnham. Following the asteroid incident, Tilly struggles to keep a grip on her reality. L'Rell's authority on Qo'noS is threatened.

Name: "An Obol for Charon"
Writer(s): Jordon Nardino, Gretchen J. Berg, Aaron Harberts, Alan McElroy, Andrew Colville
Summary: A mysterious sphere threatens the USS Discovery even as May, in her original form, implements a plan that puts Tilly's life in danger. Saru and Burnham's bond grows when Saru is forced to acknowledge a deeply unsettling Kelpien truth. Pike receives new intel on Spock from a loyal friend.

Name: "Saints of Imperfection"
Summary: Burnham and the crew navigate a dangerous alien landscape in a race against time to save Tilly's life, but Stamets is not at all prepared for what they find in the process. Section 31 is assigned to help track down Spock, much to Pike's dismay.

Name: "The Sound of Thunder"
Summary: When a new signal appears over Saru's home planet, Burnham, Saru and the crew embark on a perilous mission that puts Saru in danger and raises questions about the Red Angel's intentions. Hugh struggles to come to terms with his new reality.

Name: "Light and Shadows"
Summary: Burnham goes to Vulcan in search of Spock, where she unearths surprising family secrets. In researching what is left of the Red Angel's signal over Kaminar, Pike and Tyler end up in battle with time itself. Georgiou has a few tricks up her sleeve for Leland and Section 31.

Name: "If Memory Serves"
Summary: Spock and Burnham head to Talos IV, where the process of healing Spock forces the siblings to confront their troubled past. Stamets desperately tries to reconnect with an increasingly disconnected Hugh, while Tyler struggles to shed the crew's suspicions of him due to his past as Voq.

Name: "Project Daedalus"
Summary: When the Discovery crew infiltrates Section 31's headquarters, suspicions arise that the crew may have a traitor in their midst. Burnham tries to help Spock but her efforts don't go as planned.

Name: "The Red Angel"
Summary: Burnham is stunned when she learns her ties to Section 31 run deeper than she ever fathomed. Armed with the identity of the Red Angel, the USS Discovery goes to work on its most critical mission to date.

Name: "Perpetual Infinity"
Summary: Burnham receives the reunion she's been longing for, but it doesn't go quite as she imagined. Georgiou and Tyler sense a disturbing change in Leland.

Name: "Through the Valley of Shadows"
Summary: A fourth signal leads the USS Discovery to an insular world, where Pike is forced to make a life-changing choice. Burnham and Spock investigate a Section 31 ship gone rogue, leading to a discovery with catastrophic consequences.

Name: "Such Sweet Sorrow"
Writer(s): Michelle Paradise, Jenny Lumet, Alex Kurtzman
Summary: When the USS Discovery's crucial mission does not go according to plan, Burnham realizes what must ultimately be done. The crew prepares for the battle of a lifetime as Leland's Control ships get closer.

Name: "Such Sweet Sorrow, Part 2"
Writer(s): Michelle Paradise, Jenny Lumet, Alex Kurtzman
Summary: The USS Discovery battles against Control in a fight not only for their lives but for the future, with a little help from some unexpected friends. Spock and Burnham discern vital new connections between the red signals while Burnham faces one of life's harshest truths: the right decisions are often the hardest to make.

Name: "That Hope Is You, Part 1"
Writer(s): Michelle Paradise, Jenny Lumet, Alex Kurtzman
Summary: Burnham navigates a strange, new galaxy, 930 years in her future, looking for the rest of the Discovery crew.

Name: "Far From Home"
Writer(s): Michelle Paradise, Jenny Lumet, Alex Kurtzman
Summary: After the USS Discovery crash-lands on a strange planet, the crew finds themselves racing against time to repair their ship. Meanwhile, Saru and Tilly embark on a perilous first-contact mission in hopes of finding Burnham.

Name: "People of Earth"
Summary: Reunited with Burnham, Discovery heads to Earth to find out what has happened to the Federation in the last thousand years.

Name: "Forget Me Not"
Writer(s): Alan McElroy, Chris Silvestri, Anthony Maranville
Summary: Burnham and Adira visit the Trill homeworld while Saru's efforts on the Discovery to help the crew reconnect yield surprises.

Name: "Die Trying"
Summary: After reuniting with what remains of Starfleet and the Federation, the USS Discovery and its crew must prove that a 930 year old crew and starship are exactly what this new future needs.

Name: "Scavengers"
Summary: After receiving a message from Book, Burnham and Georgiou embark on a rogue mission to find him, leaving Saru to pick up the pieces with Admiral Vance. Meanwhile, Stamets forms an unexpected bond with Adira.

Name: "Unification III"
Summary: While grappling with the fallout of her recent actions, and what her future might hold, Burnham agrees to represent the Federation in an intense debate about the release of politically sensitive – but highly valuable – Burn data.

Name: "The Sanctuary"
Summary: Burnham and the USS Discovery crew travel to Book's home planet to help rescue it from Osyraa, the formidable leader of the Emerald Chain. Meanwhile, Stamets and Adira continue their search for valuable information on the origin of the Burn.

Name: "Terra Firma, Part 1"
Writer(s): Bo Yeon Kim, Erika Lippoldt, Alan McElroy
Summary: The USS Discovery crew journeys to a mysterious planet in hopes of finding a cure for Georgiou's deteriorating condition. Stamets and Adira make a stunning breakthrough with the newly acquired Burn data.

Name: "Terra Firma, Part 2"
Writer(s): Kalinda Vazquez, Bo Yeon Kim, Erika Lippoldt, Alan McElroy
Summary: Georgiou uncovers the true depths of the plot against her, leading her to a revelation about how deeply her time on the USS Discovery truly changed her.

Name: "Su'Kal"
Summary: Discovery ventures to the Verubin Nebula, where Burnham, Saru, and Culber make a shocking realization about the origin of The Burn as the rest of the crew faces an unexpected threat.

Name: "There Is A Tide..."
Summary: After capturing the USS Discovery, Osyraa seeks a meeting with Admiral Vance while Burnham and the crew must overcome unimaginable odds as they attempt to regain command of their ship.

Name: "That Hope Is You, Part 2"
Summary: As the Emerald Chain tightens its grip and the mystery of the Burn is finally solved, Burnham and the crew have one last chance to save themselves – and the Federation.

Name: "Kobayashi Maru"
Writer(s): Michelle Paradise, Jenny Lumet, Alex Kurtzman
Summary: After months spent reconnecting the Federation with distant worlds, Captain Michael Burnham and the crew of the USS Discovery are sent to assist a damaged space station – a seemingly routine mission that reveals the existence of a terrifying new threat.

Name: "Anomaly (DIS)"
Summary: Saru returns to help the USS Discovery uncover the mystery of an unusually destructive new force. As Burnham leads the crew, she must also find a way to help Book cope with an unimaginable loss.

Name: "Choose to Live"
Summary: Burnham and Tilly hunt the killer of a Starfleet officer as Stamets and the science team race against the clock to prevent the anomaly from killing anyone else.

Name: "All Is Possible"
Summary: Tilly and Adira lead a team of Starfleet Academy cadets on a training mission that takes a dangerous turn. Meanwhile, Burnham is pulled into tense negotiations on Ni'Var.

Name: "The Examples"
Summary: Burnham and Book race to evacuate a group of stranded colonists in the anomaly's path as one of the Federation's brightest scientists comes aboard the USS Discovery to do high-stakes research with Saru and Stamets.

Name: "Stormy Weather"
Summary: Seeking answers, the USS Discovery ventures into a subspace rift created by the Dark Matter Anomaly. Meanwhile, Book faces a strange visitor from his past.

Name: "...But to Connect"
Summary: Tensions rise as representatives from across the galaxy gather to confront the threat of the Dark Matter Anomaly. Zora's new sentience raises difficult questions.

Name: "All In"
Summary: Following a hunch, Captain Burnham tracks Book to an old haunt from their courier days and gets drawn into a high-stakes competition for a powerful weapon.

Name: "Rubicon"
Summary: Captain Burnham and the USS Discovery race to stop Book and Ruon Tarka from launching a rogue plan that could inadvertently endanger the galaxy.

Name: "The Galactic Barrier"
Summary: Captain Burnham and her crew must go where few have gone before: beyond the Galactic Barrier. Meanwhile, Book learns the truth of what drives Ruon Tarka.

Name: "Rosetta"
Summary: While Captain Burnham leads an away mission to a planet that was once home to the aliens responsible for the DMA, Book and Tarka secretly infiltrate the USS Discovery.

Name: "Species Ten-C"
Summary: As the DMA approaches Earth and Ni'Var, Captain Burnham and the crew of the USS Discovery attempt to make first contact with the powerful species responsible before it's too late.

Name: "Coming Home"
Summary: The DMA approaches Earth and Ni'Var. With evacuations underway, Burnham and the team aboard the USS Discovery must find a way to communicate and connect with a species far different from their own before time runs out.

Name: "Red Directive"
Summary: Captain Burnham and the USS Discovery are sent to retrieve a mysterious 800-year-old Romulan vessel; until the artifact hidden inside is stolen, leading to an epic chase. Meanwhile, Saru is offered the position of a lifetime, and Tilly's efforts to help pull her into a tangled web of secrecy.

Name: "Under the Twin Moons"
Summary: On Saru's last mission as Captain Burnham's Number One, the team ventures to a seemingly abandoned planet to hunt for what might be the greatest treasure in the galaxy.

Name: "Jinaal"
Summary: On Trill, Burnham, Booker, and Culber must pass a dangerous test to prove themselves worthy of the next clue. Adira reconnects with Gray, and Saru's first day as ambassador is complicated by his engagement to T'Rina.

Name: "Face the Strange"
Summary: On the way to the next clue, the USS Discovery is sabotaged by a mysterious weapon, leaving Captain Burnham, Rayner, and Stamets as the only crew members who can possibly save the ship in time.

Name: "Mirrors"
Summary: Captain Burnham and Book journey into extradimensional space in search of the next clue to the location of the Progenitors' power. Meanwhile, Rayner navigates his first mission in command of the USS Discovery, and Culber opens up to Tilly.

Name: "Whistlespeak"
Summary: While undercover in a pre-warp society, Captain Burnham is forced to consider breaking the Prime Directive when a local tradition threatens Tilly's life. Meanwhile, Culber tries to connect with Stamets, and Adira steps up when Rayner assigns them a position on the bridge.

Name: "Erigah"
Summary: With Moll and L'ak in custody, the Federation is pulled into a diplomatic and ethical firestorm when the Breen demand they be handed over. Meanwhile, Booker looks for ways to help as Tilly, Adira, and Reno work to decipher the latest clue.

Name: "Labyrinths"
Summary: When Captain Burnham is trapped with a mindscape designed to test her worthiness to retrieve the Progenitors' powerful technology, Booker, Rayner, and the crew of the USS Discovery must hold off the Breen long enough for her to escape.

Name: "Lagrange Point"
Summary: After Moll and the Breen capture a mysterious structure that contains the Progenitors' power, Captain Burnham must lead a covert mission to retrieve it before the Breen figure out how to use it.

Name: "Life, Itself"
Summary: Trapped inside a mysterious alien portal that defies familiar rules of time, space, and gravity, Captain Burnham must fight Moll – and the environment itself – in order to locate the Progenitors' technology and secure it for the Federation. Meanwhile, Booker puts himself in harm's way to help Burnham survive and Rayner leads the USS Discovery in an epic winner-takes-all battle against Breen forces.

Name: "Remembrance"
Writer(s): Akiva Goldsman, Michael Chabon, Kirsten Beyer, Alex Kurtzman, James Duff
Summary: At the end of the 24th century, and fourteen years after his retirement from Starfleet, Jean-Luc Picard is living a quiet life on his vineyard, Château Picard. When he is sought out by a mysterious young woman, Dahj, in need of his help, he soon realizes she may have personal connections to his own past.

Name: "Maps and Legends"
Summary: Picard begins investigating the mystery of Dahj as well as what her very existence means to the Federation. Without Starfleet's support, Picard is left leaning on others for help, including Dr. Agnes Jurati and an estranged former colleague, Raffi Musiker. Meanwhile, hidden enemies are also interested in where Picard's search for the truth about Dahj will lead.

Name: "The End is the Beginning"
Summary: Completely unaware of her special nature, Soji continues her work and captures the attention of the Borg cube research project's executive director.
